title: Negotiation on the A2A SendMessage wire

invariants.statement: THE SYSTEM SHALL accept negotiation actions as A2A SendMessage JSON-RPC requests interoperable with the official a2a-sdk client, answering each turn with the task envelope and a typed error object on refusal.
invariants.property: forall turns t: (valid(t) => applies(sm, t) and ledgered(t) and sdk_parseable(answer(t))) and (invalid(t) => typed_error(t))

check.notes: tests/unit/test_negotiate_transport.py + tests/e2e/test_negotiate_transport_resumption.py — a2a-sdk JsonRpcTransport as the client; kill -9 mid-wire-protocol, restart resumes the same run
